brief:
Zeteo reported that Netflix is continuing to platform "Fauda," an Israeli television drama series, as its co-creator announced that Season 5 will function as "a blood-revenge season inspired by real stories that happened after Oct. 7." The show has faced sustained criticism from observers who contend it presents Palestinians in dehumanizing terms across multiple seasons.

Critics have argued that the forthcoming season will extend the pattern of Palestinian characterization established by previous installments. The renewal decision arrives amid broader debate over streaming platforms' editorial choices in distributing and promoting content centered on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The series has attracted particular scrutiny since the escalation of hostilities in October 2023.
dek: The show’s co-creator promises Season 5 ‘is a blood-revenge season inspired by real stories that happened after Oct. 7.’ We know all too well that means another season of dehumanizing Palestinians.
title: Netflix renews Israeli drama series amid Palestinian dehumanization criticism
